Question 2
?

Given that L{tsin⁡(ωt)}=2ωs(s2+ω2)2, find the Laplace transform L{e3t⋅tsin⁡(5t)}.

a
10(s−3)(s−3)2+25
b
10(s+3)((s+3)2+25)2
c
10s((s−3)2+25)2
d
10(s−3)((s−3)2+9)2
e
10(s−3)((s−3)2+25)2
